mapper.select: select tsd.test_session_detail_id, tsd.sign_word_id, sw.sign_word_name, sw.sign_word_thumbnail, tsd.user_answer, tsd.answer_date, tsd.question_no, ts.test_session_type from test_session_detail tsd join test_session ts on tsd.test_session_id = ts.test_session_id join sign_word sw on tsd.sign_word_id = sw.sign_word_id where ts.member_id = #{memberId} and tsd.is_correct = 'N' and ts.test_session_type = #{category} order by tsd.answer_date desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select count(*) from test_session_detail tsd join test_session ts on tsd.test_session_id = ts.test_session_id where ts.member_id = #{memberId} and tsd.is_correct = 'N' and ts.test_session_type = #{category}
